newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacia & Upjohn's Dostinex now for sale.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn's Dostinex now for sale.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc said Tuesday its Dostinex tablets for treatment hyperprolactinemic disorders, a pituitary gland problem, is now available by prescription in the United States.

Factory shipments have begun for Dostinex, which the company said can be taken twice a week. That compares to doses of up to twice a day for bromocriptine, the only other drug on the market for treating hyperprolactinemia, the firm said.
Hyperprolactinemia is usually caused by a benign tumor on the pituitary gland that results in excess production of prolactin, the hormone that controls lactation, according to Pharmacia & Upjohn.

Doctors treat from 70,000 to 100,000 patients with the condition each year, the vast majority of whom are women. The disorder mostly affects women ages 20-50 and can cause cessation of menstruation, excessive breast milk discharge and infertility due to anovulation.
In men, the condition can cause decreased libido and impotence.
